prompt: Write a list of 20 animated films from the 1990s, in the following format: “[TITLE] ([YEAR]), by [DIRECTORS]”. Do not write any descriptions, or sort in any order.
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 is the only response that cleanly satisfies the task: it lists 20 animated films with release years all in the 1990s, and each entry follows the requested “Title (Year), by Directors” format without descriptions. Candidate 2 includes multiple entries released in 2000 (outside the 1990s), which is a major violation, though many other entries are still on-target. Candidate 3 includes several non-animated and/or out-of-decade films (e.g., Monsters, Inc. 2001, Flubber 1997 (live-action), etc.), making it largely non-responsive. Candidate 4 is similarly incorrect on animation/decade, and it also adds explanatory parenthetical notes, directly violating the “no descriptions” constraint.
